text:
Claire Donovan: Hi all  first day! I accepted the org invite but cant open "Product Library v3" in Figma (shows Request access). Also where do I find the canonical roadmap/PRDs and the research consent + payment process? Thanks!

Hamid Alvi: welcome Claire! :tada: I just resent the Figma invite and added you to the Product Designers group. Join #design-ops and Product Onboarding in Notion. If you still see "Request access" try the steps below.

Rina Soto: Hey Claire  Im your PM. PRDs + roadmap live in Notion under /product/PRDs and /product/roadmap. I can add you directly if SSO blocks you. Use this read link if urgent: https://notion.redwood.com/product/roadmap (SSO required).

DesignBot: Claire Donovan has been added to teams: Product Designers, Design System; invited to Lookback.

Hamid Alvi: Troubleshooting I send to new hires usually:
```
1) Sign out of Figma
2) Sign in via Okta/SSO (company domain)
3) Open invite link in a fresh/private window
4) If still blocked, paste a screenshot here or DM me your work email
```

Claire Donovan: Tried incognito + SSO, still Request access for the prototype file (not the library). Screenshot attached.

Hamid Alvi: Thanks  I force-added you to the prototype and the Product Library file. Can you confirm you can open both now? Also watch for multiple Google accounts in the browser if you use that.

Claire Donovan: I can open both now  super fast help, thanks! Quick follow-up: wheres the dev handoff checklist and how do we contribute to design tokens (repo/PR process)?

Rina Soto: Handoff checklist = Notion > Design > Handoff + a Figma page called "Handoff Checklist" in Product Library. Short: tokens mapped, export slices named, dev-mode comments, link to PRD. For tokens: open a PR in https://github.com/redwood/design-tokens, tag @design-system-review; small changes get two reviewers.

Oliver Grant: Research ops FYI  consent templates + payment flows live in Notion > Research Ops. Payments go through Stripe Connect; we use prepaid cards for ad-hoc testers. New designers can shadow Fri 11am Observe & Debrief. Claire, Ill add you to Lookback and the research calendar.

Claire Donovan: Fri 11am works for me. Thanks everyone  excited to jump in :rocket:
